proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL TO REPORT ON CRITERIA FOR SELECTING COUNTRIES FOR OPERATIONS
proposals.proponent: The National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the Board review guidelines for selecting countries and regions for operations and issue a report on criteria for investing in, operating in and withdrawing from high-risk regions, including human rights.
proposals.evidence: THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS THAT SHAREHOLDERS VOTE "AGAINST" THE SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL TO REPORT ON CRITERIA FOR SELECTING COUNTRIES FOR OPERATIONS.
